These factors imply that East India Drums & Barrels Manufacturing Ltd may be undervalued by the market, and investors should consider buying the stock as it sits at a discount to its historical range. Secondly, the stock's P/E ratio of 29.02x against a sector benchmark of 18.13x [E6] further supports this argument. This suggests a lack of sustainable revenue growth, another red flag in this valuation analysis. This further supports the notion that the stock may be overvalued.
